data.name: InstallLabel
data.comment: Button label under the install question in the update window; pressing it downloads and runs the installer. Short: the buttons sit one per line in a narrow window.

data.name: LaterLabel
data.comment: Button label under the install question; pressing it closes the window and installs nothing. Short, as InstallLabel.

data.name: ReleasePageLabel
data.comment: Button label under the install question; pressing it opens the release's web page. Short, as InstallLabel.

data.name: CloseLabel
data.comment: Button label under a message in the update window, and the screen-reader name of the cross in its corner; both close the window. Short, as InstallLabel.

data.name: CancelDownloadLabel
data.comment: Button label while the installer downloads; pressing it stops the download and closes the window. Short, as InstallLabel.

data.name: AvailableHeadline
data.comment: Heading over the install question. {0} = the new version, for example 1.2.3; no full stop.

data.name: InstallBody
data.value: Versjon {0} er installert. Installasjonsprogrammet lastes ned og kontrolleres før det kjøres, og {1} lukkes når det starter.
data.comment: Text under the install question's heading. {0} = the running version; {1} = the application's name as the subject, inserted as written, which Norwegian does not inflect.

data.name: DownloadingHeadline
data.comment: Heading while the installer downloads. {0} = the new version; no full stop.

data.name: DownloadBody
data.comment: Text under the download heading. {0} = the application's name as the subject, inserted as written, which Norwegian does not inflect.

data.name: DownloadProgress
data.comment: Line under the download progress bar. {0} = megabytes received, {1} = megabytes in total, both with one decimal in the reader's number format.

data.name: DownloadProgressSoFar
data.comment: Line under the download progress bar where the total size is unknown. {0} = megabytes received, with one decimal in the reader's number format.

data.name: VerifyingText
data.comment: Line under the full progress bar while the downloaded installer is checked. Replaces DownloadProgress at the same place.

data.name: VerifyingHeadline
data.comment: Heading while the downloaded installer is checked. {0} = the new version; no full stop.

data.name: UpToDateHeadline
data.comment: Heading over the notice that no newer version exists. No full stop.

data.name: UpToDateText
data.comment: Text under UpToDateHeadline. {0} = the running version.

data.name: NothingReleasedHeadline
data.comment: Heading over the notice that the application has never published a version. No full stop.

data.name: NothingReleasedText
data.comment: Text under NothingReleasedHeadline.

data.name: CheckFailedHeadline
data.value: Søket etter oppdateringer ble ikke fullført
data.comment: Heading over a message saying why the search for a newer version failed. No full stop.

data.name: CheckRateLimited
data.value: GitHub avviste søket etter oppdateringer fordi grensen for antall forespørsler er nådd. Prøv igjen etter {0:t}.
data.comment: Text under CheckFailedHeadline when GitHub refused for too many requests. {0} = the local clock time the limit lifts, in the reader's short time format.

data.name: CheckRateLimitedLater
data.value: GitHub avviste søket etter oppdateringer fordi grensen for antall forespørsler er nådd. Prøv igjen om en stund.
data.comment: As CheckRateLimited, where GitHub gave no time.

data.name: CheckUnreachable
data.comment: Text under CheckFailedHeadline. {0} = an English clause naming the cause, which stays English in every language.

data.name: CheckTimedOut
data.comment: Text under CheckFailedHeadline. {0} = an English clause naming the cause, which stays English in every language.

data.name: CheckRequestFailed
data.comment: Text under CheckFailedHeadline. {0} = an English clause naming the cause, which stays English in every language.

data.name: CheckInvalidResponse
data.value: Oppdateringstjenesten svarte med noe denne versjonen ikke forstår: {0}.
data.comment: Text under CheckFailedHeadline. {0} = an English clause naming the cause, which stays English in every language.

data.name: CheckFailedOther
data.value: Søket etter oppdateringer ble ikke fullført: {0}.
data.comment: Text under CheckFailedHeadline for any other cause. {0} = an English clause naming the cause, which stays English in every language.

data.name: CannotInstallHeadline
data.comment: Heading over a refusal to install. {0} = the new version; no full stop.

data.name: HashNotPublished
data.value: Utgivelsen oppgir ingen SHA-256 for installasjonsprogrammet, så en nedlasting kunne ikke kontrolleres mot den, og ingenting ble lastet ned.
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline. RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: HashAmbiguous
data.value: Utgivelsen oppgir mer enn én SHA-256, så verdien for installasjonsprogrammet kan ikke skilles fra de andre, og ingenting ble lastet ned.
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline. RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: InstallerAssetMissing
data.value: Utgivelsen har ingen fil med navnet {0}, så det var ingenting å laste ned.
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline. {0} = the installer's file name; RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: DownloadFailed
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline. {0} = an English clause naming the cause, which stays English; RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: NotInstalledOther
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline for any other cause. {0} = an English clause naming the cause, which stays English; RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: RefusedHashMismatch
data.value: Det nedlastede installasjonsprogrammet er ikke filen utgivelsen publiserte: {0}.
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline. {0} = an English clause naming both hashes, which stays English; RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: RefusedNotSigned
data.value: Det nedlastede installasjonsprogrammet har ingen signatur, så ingenting viser hvem som har laget det.
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline. RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: RefusedSignatureInvalid
data.value: Det nedlastede installasjonsprogrammet er endret etter at det ble signert.
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline. RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: RefusedSignerMismatch
data.value: Det nedlastede installasjonsprogrammet er signert av en annen utgiver: {0}.
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline. {0} = an English clause naming the publisher found, which stays English; RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: RefusedCertificateNotPinned
data.value: Det nedlastede installasjonsprogrammet har den forventede utgiverens navn, men på et sertifikat denne versjonen ikke godtar: {0}.
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline: the right publisher name on a certificate not accepted. {0} = an English clause naming the certificate, which stays English; RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: RefusedFileMissing
data.value: Det nedlastede installasjonsprogrammet var borte før det kunne kontrolleres.
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline. RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: RefusedSignatureCheckFailed
data.value: Windows avviste signaturen på det nedlastede installasjonsprogrammet: {0}.
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline. {0} = an English clause with the Windows code, which stays English; RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: RefusedOther
data.comment: Reason under CannotInstallHeadline for any other verdict. {0} = an English clause naming the cause, which stays English; RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: RefusalAdvice
data.value: Filen ble ikke kjørt. Oppdater fra utgivelsessiden i stedet.
data.comment: Closing paragraph after every refusal and failed start, after a blank line. ReleasePageLabel names the same page.

data.name: LaunchFailedHeadline
data.comment: Heading over a message that the verified installer would not start. No full stop.

data.name: LaunchFailedText
data.comment: Text under LaunchFailedHeadline. {0} = an English clause naming the cause, which stays English; RefusalAdvice follows after a blank line.

data.name: HeldHeadline
data.comment: Heading when the application is busy and holds the install. {0} = the new version; no full stop.

data.name: HeldText
data.value: Oppdateringen startet ikke fordi {0}. Prøv igjen når det er ferdig.
data.comment: Text under HeldHeadline. {0} = a lower-case clause saying what is busy, written by the application or one of HoldUnreadable, MachineInUse, InstallerRunning; after "fordi" it takes subordinate word order.

data.name: HoldUnreadable
data.value: programmet ikke kunne avgjøre om det er opptatt
data.comment: Clause inserted after "fordi" in HeldText where the application's busy check failed. Lower case, no full stop, subordinate word order ("ikke" before the verb) to fit that sentence.

data.name: MachineInUse
data.comment: Clause inserted after "fordi" in HeldText, and the reason an unattended install waits, when someone is using the computer. Lower case, no full stop, subordinate word order to fit that sentence.

data.name: InstallerRunning
data.comment: Clause inserted after "fordi" in HeldText, and the reason an unattended install does nothing, once the installer has started. Lower case, no full stop, subordinate word order ("allerede" before the verb) to fit that sentence.
